title: LLMs Can Tackle High Energy Theoretical Physics, yet Gaps Remain: Part I, Quantum Field Theory
abstract: arXiv:2610.33134v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Beyond math and code, Large language models (LLMs) are beginning to tackle problems that have traditionally required substantial training for theoretical physicists, but it remains unclear how far this capability extends and where it might break. As a first step toward pushing LLMs in high-energy theoretical physics, we introduce QFT-Bench, a benchmark of 75 graduate- to research-level problems requiring extensive reasoning and derivation across core Quantum Field Theory (QFT) subareas. Each question has a well-defined target and closed-form reference answer. Evaluation combines symbolic verification with LLM-based judge. Across 39 proprietary and open-source models, frontier models already demonstrate substantial capabilities on nontrivial QFT calculations, with the strongest models exceeding 95% accuracy. At the same time, clear gaps remain. Even strong models still make errors in calculations, conventions, and instruction following,

translated_title: 大语言模型能够攻克高能理论物理，但仍存在差距：第一部分，量子场论
translated_abstract: 除了数学和编程之外，大语言模型（LLMs）开始能够处理传统上需要理论物理学家经过大量训练才能解决的问题，但这种能力究竟能延伸到什么程度、在哪里可能会失效，目前仍不清楚。作为推动大语言模型在高能理论物理领域发展的第一步，我们提出了QFT-Bench，这是一个包含75道研究生至研究级问题的基准测试，这些问题需要在量子场论（QFT）的核心子领域进行深入的推理和推导。每个问题都有明确定义的目标和闭式参考答案。评估方法结合了符号验证与基于大语言模型的评判。在39个专有和开源模型中，前沿模型在非平凡的量子场论计算上已经展现出可观的能力，最强的模型准确率超过95%。与此同时，明显的差距仍然存在。即使是强大的模型，在计算、约定和指令遵循方面仍会出错。
tldr: 该论文提出了包含75道研究生至研究级量子场论问题的QFT-Bench基准测试，评估显示最强的大语言模型准确率已超过95%，但在计算、约定和指令遵循方面仍存在明显差距。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces QFT-Bench, a benchmark of 75 graduate- to research-level quantum field theory problems, revealing that the strongest LLMs achieve over 95% accuracy while clear gaps remain in calculations, conventions, and instruction following.
